hook.name: SentryInkWethXStockHook
hook.description: A token launch hook with a time-decaying fee schedule (exponential half-life decay from startFee to endFee). On each swap, WETH fees are skimmed and distributed among reflection, creator, pot, and sink recipients. Liquidity additions are restricted to a factory-authorized vault. Whitelisted launch participants receive a discounted fee on buys during the launch window.
